AI Agent Skills Directory

90 Production-Grade AI Agent Skills for OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex & Gemini CLI
Command Palette-Driven · Conversational Recommendations · MCP Server Stacks

--- ## What is AI Agent Skills? AI Agent Skills is a **search-first directory** of 90 production-grade skills for AI coding agents — OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. Think of it as a **Raycast-style skill store** for developer AI agents: browse by zone, search by keyword, get conversational recommendations, and install with one command. Every skill is a self-contained instruction module that supercharges your AI coding agent with domain expertise — from GSAP animation engineering to MCP server building, from SEO content writing to Jobs-to-be-Done product research. ## Live Demo **[marktantongco.github.io/ai-agent-skills](https://marktantongco.github.io/ai-agent-skills)** ## Quick Start ### Install Any Skill ```bash # Install a skill with one command npx skills add https://github.com/marktantongco/ai-agent-skills --skill gsap-animations # Or install from source skills.sh repos npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill chain-of-thought npx skills add anthropics/skills --skill frontend-design ``` ### Browse Skills by Zone | Zone | Categories | Skills | Description | |------|-----------|--------|-------------| | ACTIVATE | Design & UI | 21 | Animation, GSAP, Motion, Supanova, UI/UX Pro Max | | BUILD | Development, MCP Servers | 17 | MCP Builder, TDD, React, 3D Orchestrator, Context7 | | VALIDATE | Reasoning, Data & Web | 10 | Chain-of-Thought, Socratic, Audit Analyzer | | PLAYBOOK | Agents, Strategy | 12 | Agent Rabbit/Owl/Ant, JTBD Research, PRD | | MONETIZE | Content, Creative | 6 | SEO Writer, Humanizer, Photography AI | | SYSTEM | System, Infrastructure | 7 | Persistent Memory, Context Compressor, Agent Roles | ### Use the Command Palette Open the skill store and press `Cmd+K` (or `Ctrl+K`) to search across all 90 skills instantly. ### Conversational Recommendations Click the chat bubble and describe what you're building. The conversational engine recommends the right skills, stacks, and workflows. ## Features ### Command Palette (`Cmd+K`) Raycast-style instant search across all 90 skills. Filter by name, category, tag, or description. Keyboard navigation with arrow keys and Enter to select. ### Zone-Based Navigation Six navigation zones organized by workflow phase: ACTIVATE, BUILD, VALIDATE, PLAYBOOK, MONETIZE, SYSTEM. Each zone shows only the relevant categories and sub-nav filters. ### Sub-Nav Tag Filtering Dynamic sub-navigation pills generated from the top tags in each zone. Click a tag to filter skills — the count updates in real-time. ### Conversational Recommendation Engine Tell the chat widget what you're building and get personalized skill recommendations with match scores, install commands, and MCP server suggestions. ### MCP Stack Curator Eight pre-curated MCP server stacks with synergy scores (75-96%). Each stack recommends 4 MCP servers that work best together: Full-Stack Builder, Content Engine, Research Pipeline, and more. ### Agent Spotlight Seven agent personality modes — Rabbit (ideation), Owl (analysis), Ant (decomposition), Eagle (strategy), Dolphin (creativity), Beaver (architecture), Elephant (synthesis). ### PWA Installable Works as a Progressive Web App. Install it on your desktop or mobile for a native app experience with offline support via service worker. ### URL API Access skills data programmatically: ``` ?format=json → Full skills dataset as JSON ?format=manifest → Compact manifest (name, category, install) ?skill=gsap-animations → Single skill detail ?category=Design+%26+UI → Filter by category ?zone=build → Navigate to a zone ?embed=true → Embeddable mode (no nav/footer) ?action=search → Auto-open command palette ?palette=supanova → Apply color palette (supanova, ocean, ember, neon) ``` ## All 90 Skills ### Design & UI (21 skills) | Skill | Description | github, docker, memory | ## Architecture ``` ai-agent-skills/ ├── docs/ # GitHub Pages source │ ├── index.html # Single-file PWA (all HTML/CSS/JS) │ ├── manifest.json # PWA manifest │ ├── sw.js # Service worker │ ├── icon-192.svg # App icon │ ├── icon-512.svg # App icon │ └── .nojekyll # Prevent Jekyll processing ├── index.html # Root redirect / standalone copy ├── README.md # This file └── package.json # Project metadata ``` ### Technical Stack - **Frontend**: Vanilla HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (zero build step) - **Animations**: GSAP v3.12.5 + ScrollTrigger - **Fonts**: Inter (variable), JetBrains Mono (monospace) - **PWA**: Service Worker, Web App Manifest, installable - **Design**: Neo-minimalism, 8pt grid, WCAG 2.2 AA compliant - **Data**: All 90 skills defined as in-file JavaScript objects - **Routing**: URL parameter-based (?zone=, ?skill=, ?category=) - **Event System**: `data-action` delegation pattern (zero inline handlers) ## Local Development ```bash # Clone the repo git clone https://github.com/marktantongco/ai-agent-skills.git cd ai-agent-skills # Serve locally (any static server works) npx serve docs/ # or python3 -m http.server 8000 --directory docs/ # Open in browser open http://localhost:8000 ``` No build step required. The entire app is a single `index.html` file. ## Contributing 1. Fork the repository 2. Create your feature branch: `git checkout -b feature/my-new-skill` 3. Add your skill to the `SKILLS_DATA` array in `docs/index.html` 4. Ensure your skill has: `name`, `category`, `description`, `icon`, `invoke`, `tags`, `accent`, `mcpServers`, `installCommand`, `source`, `installs` 5. Commit your changes: `git commit -m 'Add my-new-skill'` 6. Push to the branch: `git push origin feature/my-new-skill` 7. Submit a pull request ## SEO & GEO Optimization This project is optimized for both traditional search engines and AI-powered answer engines (Generative Engine Optimization): - **Structured Data**: JSON-LD `SoftwareApplication` schema - **Open Graph**: Full OG meta tags for social sharing - **Twitter Cards**: `summary_large_image` card type - **Semantic HTML**: Proper heading hierarchy, ARIA labels, roles - **PWA Manifest**: Complete with shortcuts, screenshots, categories - **URL API**: Machine-readable endpoints (?format=json, ?format=manifest) - **Keyword-rich content**: Natural integration of "AI agent skills", "MCP servers", "OpenCode", "Claude Code", "Codex", "Gemini CLI" - **Performance**: Zero build step, single file, lazy-loaded GSAP - **Accessibility**: WCAG 2.2 AA contrast ratios, focus-visible outlines, reduced motion support ## License MIT License — see [LICENSE](LICENSE) for details. ## Links - **Live Demo**: [marktantongco.github.io/ai-agent-skills](https://marktantongco.github.io/ai-agent-skills) - **GitHub**: [github.com/marktantongco/ai-agent-skills](https://github.com/marktantongco/ai-agent-skills) - **Original Repo**: [github.com/marktantongco/opencode-accomplishments](https://github.com/marktantongco/opencode-accomplishments) - **Skills Standard**: [skills.sh](https://skills.sh) ---
